title: Assessing lineage and cytolytic functional potential of murine tissue-resident innate lymphocytes
protocol: Generate S1pr5FM bone marrow chimeras.
Select S1pr5FM mice with minimal leaky FM expression in peripheral blood to use as bone marrow donors.
Warm mouse by putting under heat lamp for 5 min.
Place mouse in restrainer and wipe tail with alcohol wipe.
Create small nick on tail vein at distal end of tail with disposable scalpel.
Collect blood with heparinized capillary tube.
Place capillary tube with blood into Eppendorf tube pre-filled with 5 μL 0.1 M EDTA.
Wrap mouse tail with paper towel and apply pressure to stop bleeding before returning mouse to cage.
Flush blood from capillary tube by pipetting ∼800 μl RBC lysis buffer into top of capillary tube, collecting it into Eppendorf tube below.
Let sit for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Transfer mixture to 15 ml conical tube and add 5 ml chilled PBS.
Spin down tube for 6 min at 550 rcf and 4°C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in 100 μl FACS buffer.
Transfer sample through a piece of nylon mesh material into a 1.2 mL polypropylene microtiter tube.
Run the sample on an LSR-II flow cytometer with FSC, SSC, FITC, and PE channels recording.
Analyze data using FlowJo software, gating on cells based on morphology.
Measure YFP expression (S1pr5FM) which should be expressed in both the FITC and PE channels.
Lethally irradiate recipient CD45.1+ C57BL/6 mice with 900 rad 12–24 hours before cell transfer.
Remove muscle from bones, place clean bones in 70% ethanol for 1-2 minutes.
Rinse bones in sterile PBS.
Mash bones using a mortar and pestle in a sterile biological safety cabinet.
Collect bone marrow in T-cell media (TCM).
Pass the collected bone marrow through a 70 μm filter to obtain a single cell suspension.
Deplete lineage cells from the bone marrow using the EasySep™ Mouse Hematopoietic Progenitor Cell Isolation Kit, following the manufacturer’s instructions.
Transfer resulting cells to 15 mL conical tubes and spin down tubes for 6 minutes at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Decant supernatant from the tubes.
Stain cells with surface antibodies.
Resuspend cells in FACS buffer with Fc Block, viability dye, and antibodies against surface proteins.
Incubate cells plus antibody cocktail for 30 min on ice, protected from light.
Wash cells by adding cold PBS to conical tube.
Spin down cells for 6 min at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Remove supernatant.
Repeat wash two more times for a total of three washes.
Resuspend cells in sorting buffer at a concentration of 20 × 10^6 cells per mL.
Transfer samples through piece of nylon mesh material into polypropylene test tube.
Sort for non-fate mapped LSKs, gating on live CD45+Lin-Sca1+c-Kit-S1pr5FM- cells.
Sort into 1 mL sort collection medium in a 15 mL conical tube.
Calibrate the cell sorter properly for the experiment.
Run appropriate compensation controls on the cell sorter.
Record a small part of the sample to use as a reference for drawing gates before collecting cells.
Transfer at least 5,000 sorted non-fate-mapped LSKs per recipient mouse.
Resuspend sorted sample in 100 μL sterile PBS per 5,000 cells.
Inject 100 μL intravenously via either tail vein or retroorbital injection into irradiated recipient mice.
Maintain recipient mice on chow supplemented with the antibiotics sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim (sulfatrim diet) for at least two weeks post-irradiation as their immune system reconstitutes.
Age mice for 4-6 weeks to allow immune system to reconstitute before analysis.
Euthanize adult S1pr5FM chimeras 4–6 weeks post-transfer and adult GzmcFM mice.
Harvest tissues of interest, including blood, spleen, and liver from the euthanized mice.
Process harvested tissues to get single-cell suspensions for downstream flow cytometric analysis.
Harvest blood via cardiac puncture and put in 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes with 50 μL 0.1 M EDTA to prevent coagulation.
Spin down Eppendorf tube for 6 min at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL RBC lysis buffer.
Transfer to 15 mL conical tube and let sit for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Add 5 mL chilled PBS and spin down for 6 min at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Resuspend in T cell media.
Keep on ice until ready for staining.
Harvest and process the spleen.
Mash tissue between two glass slides in 2 mL chilled PBS in a 60 × 15 mm tissue culture dish.
Pass mashed tissue through 70 μm cell strainer into 50 mL conical tube, mashing tissue with the flat end of 3 mL syringe plunger through strainer.
Transfer cells to 15 mL conical tube.
Spin down tube for 6 min at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellet in 5 mL RBC lysis buffer.
Let sit for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
To wash, add 5 mL chilled PBS and spin tube for 6 min at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellet in ∼5 mL T cell media.
Keep on ice until ready for staining.
Harvest and process the liver.
Chop organ with razor blade on glass slide.
Place minced tissue in 15 mL conical tube with 5 mL HBSS w/o Ca2+, Mg2+ + 1 mg/mL Collagenase D.
Vortex for 5 s, incubate in 37°C water bath for 30 min, vortexing every 15 min.
Pass digested tissue through 70 μm cell strainer into 50 mL conical tube, mashing tissue with the flat end of 3 mL syringe plunger through strainer.
Rinse strainer with 15 mL PBS.
Spin down tubes for 6 minutes at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Remove supernatant and resuspend in 7 mL of 44% Percoll.
Transfer cells + 44% Percoll to a 15 mL conical tube.
Slowly add 3 mL of 66% Percoll to the bottom of the tube without disturbing the interface.
Spin samples for 30 minutes at 4°C and 1,900 rcf without brake.
Collect cells at the interface and transfer to a new 15 mL conical tube.
Bring up volume to 15 mL with chilled PBS.
Vortex well to ensure no Percoll interface re-forms.
Spin down tube for 6 minutes at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Decant supernatant.
Inspect tube before decanting supernatant to ensure cells are pelleted at the bottom of the tube.
Stain single-cell suspensions of tissues for flow cytometric analysis.
Plate samples into 96 well U-bottom plates, no more than 1 × 10^6 cells per well.
Stain cells with antibodies against surface proteins.
Spin down samples on plate for 3 minutes at 4°C and 700 rcf.
Dump supernatant.
Resuspend each sample in 50 μL of FACS buffer containing 1 μg FcBlock, viability marker, and antibodies against surface proteins conjugated to compatible fluorochromes.
Incubate samples for 30 min on ice protected from light in the presence of surface markers and intracellular antibodies as specified.
Add 150 μL chilled FACS buffer, spin down samples for 3 min at 4°C and 700 rcf and remove supernatant.
Wash twice with FACS buffer by spinning down samples for 3 min at 4°C and 700 rcf, removing supernatant, and resuspending in 200 μL FACS buffer for each wash.
Fix and permeabilize cells according to the protocol.
Incubate for 30 min on ice protected from light after adding 150 μL Fix/Perm buffer per well.

Add 150 μL Fix/Perm buffer to each well, spin samples down for 3 min at 4°C and 860 rcf, and wash twice with Fix/Perm buffer by removing supernatant, resuspending cells in 200 μL Fix/Perm buffer, and spinning down samples for 3 min at 4°C and 860 rcf.
Stain cells with antibodies against intracellular proteins resuspended in 50 μL Fix/Perm buffer containing the specified intracellular antibodies.
Incubate stained samples for 30 min on ice protected from light.
Add 150 μL Fix/Perm buffer to each well.
Spin the plate down for 3 min at 4°C and 860 rcf.
Remove the supernatant.
Wash each sample twice with Fix/Perm buffer by removing the supernatant, resuspending in 200 μL Fix/Perm buffer, and spinning the plate down for 3 min at 4°C and 860 rcf after each wash.
If a secondary intracellular antibody is required, repeat steps involving the antibody application with appropriate antibodies.
Once cells are fixed, store them at 4°C protected from light for up to 24 h before performing intracellular staining or running on a flow cytometer.
After completing the staining, resuspend samples in 100 μL FACS buffer.
Pass each sample through a piece of nylon mesh material into a 1.2 mL polypropylene microtiter tube before analysis.
Run samples on a flow cytometer (e.g., BD LSR-II or Fortessa).
Include appropriate compensation controls for the analysis.
Analyze samples using FlowJo software.
Use young mice, aged 4–6 weeks old, for optimal ILCp harvest.
Harvest bone marrow from the tibia, femur, and humerus bones of ∼6 week-old mice.
Stain bone marrow cells for sorting after harvesting.
Deplete Lineage+ cells from the harvested bone marrow.
Spin down cells after depletion and resuspend in FACS buffer with FcBlock, viability dye, and fluorescently conjugated antibodies.
Incubate stained cells at 4°C and protected from light for 30 minutes.
Add 5 ml of FACS buffer to the tube post-staining.
Centrifuge tubes for 6 min at 4°C and 550 rcf after staining.
Discard supernatant following centrifugation.
Resuspend pellet in 5 ml of FACS buffer after discarding supernatant.
Resuspend cells in sorting buffer to achieve a concentration of 20 × 10^6 cells per mL using a 70 μm nozzle on the sorter.
Pass the suspension through a piece of nylon mesh material into a 5 mL polypropylene test tube before sorting.
Sort for ILCp using an Aria II with a 70 μm nozzle according to the gating strategy: Live, lineage-NK1.1-, CD127+, α4β7+, Flt3-, PD-1+, CD25-.
Sort into 1 mL sort collection medium in a 15 mL conical tube.
Calibrate the sorter properly and run appropriate compensation controls before sorting.
Resuspend sorted sample in 100 μL sterile PBS per 4,000 cells for injection.
Inject 100 μL intravenously via tail vein or retroorbital injection into irradiated recipient mice.
Analyze recipient mice after approximately 4 weeks.
Euthanize recipient mice and harvest organs of interest, including spleen and liver.
Euthanize GzmctdT-iCre/+ and GzmctdT-iCre/+Prf1−/− mice.
Harvest organs of interest, i.e., liver.
Process liver to get single cell suspension for downstream cell sorting.
Resuspend pellet in appropriate volume (50 μL per 1 × 10^6 cells) FACS buffer with a viability dye and fluorescently conjugated antibodies against surface proteins.
Mix FcBlock at a concentration of 1 μg per 50 μL.
Pipette CXCR6-BV421 antibody at a dilution of 1:200.
Add CD49a-aF647 antibody at a dilution of 1:200.
Pipette NK1.1-APC-Cy7 antibody at a dilution of 1:100.
Incubate the mixture on ice for 30 min protected from light.
Add 5 mL FACS buffer to the tube and mix.
Spin the tube down at 4°C and 550 rcf for 6 min.
Discard the supernatant after spinning.
Resuspend the pellet in 5 mL FACS buffer.
Repeat steps vi through ix for an additional wash.
Resuspend the final pellet in sorting buffer to achieve a concentration of 20 × 10^6 cells per mL.
Pass the sample through nylon mesh material into a 5 mL polypropylene test tube before sorting.
Sort cells on FACSAria and collect GzmctdT+ and GzmctdT- ILC1 (Live CD45+NK1.1+CXCR6+CD3-CD49a+) from Prf1+/+ and Prf1−/− mice.
Sort the collected cells into 1 mL sorting collection medium in 15 mL conical tubes.
Calibrate the sorter properly for the experiment.
Run appropriate compensation controls on the sorter.
Record a small part of the sample after compensation to draw gates.
Spin down sorted samples for 6 min at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Resuspend pellet in TCM containing 100 ng/mL murine IL-15/IL-15rα complex at up to 50,000 cells per 200 μL.
Plate 200 μL of sorted cells per well of a 96 U-bottom plate.
Incubate and expand sorted effector cells at 37°C in an incubator for 7 days.
Refresh media and IL-15/IL-15rα complex after 3–4 days.
Select confluent dish(es) of RMA-S cells.
Remove media from the dish and wash twice with 10 mL PBS.
Add 3 mL trypsin to the dish and incubate for 5 min at 37°C.
Pipette cells and trypsin up and down, passing over surface of the dish a few times to remove adherent cells.
Transfer cells and trypsin to a 15 mL conical tube.
Wash the dish with TCM and add it to the tube, bringing volume up to 15 mL.
Spin down the tube for 6 min at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Remove supernatant from the tube.
Resuspend cells in 20 μL DMSO containing CellTrace Violet (CTV) dye.
Add 1 μL CTV to 1 mL PBS.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL PBS.
Add 1 mL PBS + CTV to cells and pipette up and down to mix (total volume of 2 mL).
Incubate in a 37°C water bath for 15 minutes.
Bring the volume up to 15 mL with warmed TCM.
Spin down the tube for 6 minutes at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of warmed TCM.
Incubate in a water bath for 10 minutes to ensure all unbound CTV is absorbed.
Take a 10 μL aliquot for counting.
Spin down the tube for 6 minutes at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Count live RMA-S cells.
Mix 10 μL of 0.4% trypan blue with 10 μL of CTV-stained RMA-S cells.
Let sit for 3 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Pipette 10 μL underneath the coverslip of a hemacytometer.
Place the hemacytometer on a brightfield microscope and count the number of cells that have not taken up the dye (live cells) in each of the four outer quadrants.
Calculate the number of live cells in the sample: (number of cells in four quadrants / 4) × (10^4) = number of cells per mL.
Then, calculate (number of cells per mL) × (total volume of cells [in mL]) for final cell number.
Resuspend RMA-S in an appropriate volume of TCM + 100 ng/mL IL-15/IL-15rα as needed for the killing experiment.
Plate 10,000 live target cells in 100 μL per well in a 96-well U-bottom plate.
Prepare effector cells on the day of the killing assay.
Determine the volume of media in each well of the effector cells.
Take a small aliquot of 10 μL from each well to count expanded effector cell populations.
Spin down the plate of cultured effector cells.
Resuspend cells in TCM + 100 ng/mL IL-15/IL-15rα to achieve a concentration of 100,000 cells per 100 μL.
Initiate killing assay by adding 100 μL (100,000) effector cells to wells with 100 μL (10,000) target cells, bringing the total volume to 200 μL.
Include wells with target cells only to determine background death rate in target cells.
Incubate for 16 h in a 37°C incubator.
Spin down plate for 3 min at 4°C and 700 rcf, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 200 μL PBS plus EDTA to break apart cell conjugates and end killing assay.
Incubate cells on ice for 30 min protected from light with viability dye (i.e., Tonbo GhostDye).
Add 150 μL FACS buffer to each well.
Spin down plate for 3 min at 4°C and 700 rcf, discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL FACS buffer.
Spin down plate for 3 min at 4°C and 700 rcf, and discard supernatant.
Repeat steps 32 and 33 for additional wash.
Resuspend samples in 100 μL FACS buffer.
Pass resuspended samples through nylon mesh material into 1.2 mL microtiter tube.
Run cells immediately on flow cytometer to measure death of target cells.
Analyze data on FlowJo software, gating on CTV+ cells to identify target cells.
Determine the percentage of target cells that died based on viability dye expression.
